resources.string: Keep Tailscale available after ACC off while the display stays dark.
Restore Wi-Fi after ACC off. Cellular remains supported when available.
Start and connect with the car

Open BYD startup settings and allow Tailpark. On DiLink 3.0, uncheck Tailpark in the startup restriction list. Check this setting after app updates. Connect once after signing in; future starts restore that connection unless you disconnect.
Open the car settings manually and allow Tailpark to start automatically.
Let Tailpark start with your car

In BYD startup settings, find Tailpark and turn OFF “Disable auto-start” (uncheck Tailpark in the restriction list). This lets Tailpark start and reconnect after the car restarts. Return here and confirm once you have checked the setting.
Please confirm that “Disable auto-start” is still OFF for Tailpark in BYD startup settings. Your previous confirmation was saved, but Tailpark cannot automatically verify this setting.
Tailpark was updated. BYD may reset startup restrictions after an update. Open BYD startup settings and make sure “Disable auto-start” is OFF for Tailpark, then return and confirm.
